construction_notes.text: City of San Jose permit PDA15-055-02 (Planned Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2025), status Approved, issue date 2026-03-04: "Planned Development Permit Amendment to allow the conversion of approximately 14,500 square feet of ground-floor retail space into 11 residential units and minor exterior modifications to an existing six-story mixed-use building on an approximately 1.69-g" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City permit layer: PRE25-036 (Enhanced Preliminary Review, filed 2025-01-23) describes converting about 14,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail into 11 units, applicant Sean McEachern (Shea Properties). ER25-101 (CEQA addendum, in-house) and PDA15-055-02 list Sean McEachern (ICS Corporate Yard Multifamily, LLC). A 2023 Development Agreement amendment (DA22-001) names ICS Corporate Yard Multifamily, LLC for the Japantown Corporation Yard Redevelopment Project.

The existing building is Sixth & Jackson, 620 N. 6th Street: six stories, 518 apartments and 19,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail, built 2023 (Shea Properties). IREI (2023-11-16) reports it was completed by Ivanhoé Cambridge and Shea Properties. State report Table A2 shows 219 units permitted at 620 N 6th St in 2019 and 219 units with certificates of occupancy in 2023.
